protocol.selection: best mean deterministic development return; all seeds retained; PPO joint selection only after bias removed and >=1M joint transitions
protocol.strong_baselines: v3 exhaustive fixed/quality schedules unchanged, plus original imitation/PPO controls; BO,EIG,VOI,random and prior included

freeze.primary_evaluation: greedy learned policy; same original legal masks, zero curriculum bias, uncached reference simulator
freeze.secondary_evaluation: one stochastic rollout per seed/mechanism, plus same-assays/common-final-estimator ablation
freeze.primary_metric: mean final target MSE; report positive paired MSE reduction when the first named method improves on its comparator
